opencli: 1.0.0
info:
  title: Greeter
  version: 1.0.0
commands:
  greet:
    description: Read greeter.yaml in the working directory and print its greeting string verbatim, followed by a newline. The person argument identifies the recipient and does not interpolate or otherwise change the configured greeting. With loud omitted (false), the greeting is unchanged; with --loud, uppercase the greeting before printing and logging it. Each successful call emits one greeted log record on stderr with the supplied person and the exact greeting printed, without the trailing newline.
    parameters:
    - name: person
      in: argument
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: loud
      in: flag
      required: false
      schema:
        type: boolean
        default: false
    responses:
      '0':
        description: Greeting printed
      '1':
        description: Invalid input
  translate:
    description: Read greeter.yaml in the working directory, translate its greeting string into the language given by the language argument, and print the translated greeting, followed by a newline. The person argument identifies the recipient and does not interpolate or otherwise change the configured or the translated greeting. With loud omitted (false), the translated greeting is unchanged; with --loud, uppercase the translated greeting before printing and logging it. Each successful call emits one greeted log record on stderr with the supplied person and the exact translated greeting printed, without the trailing newline.
    parameters:
    - name: person
      in: argument
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: language
      in: argument
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: loud
      in: flag
      required: false
      schema:
        type: boolean
        default: false
    responses:
      '0':
        description: Translated greeting printed
      '1':
        description: Invalid input
extensions:
  files:
    greeting-config:
      path: greeter.yaml
      format: YAML mapping with a greeting string; greet reads that string as literal text, without placeholders or person substitution
      access: read
  log_records:
    greeted:
      message: Greeting printed
      format: logfmt on stderr with person equal to the person argument and greeting equal to the printed greeting without its trailing newline; for translate the printed greeting is the translated text
  outgoing_calls:
    notify:
      command: notifier
      arguments:
      - --person
      - '{person}'
